parts.name: Mobile Phone (Other)
parts.Basic_description: A mobile phone placed on the laptop base, made of aluminum alloy with glass screen, compact and rectangular in shape.
parts.Functional_description: Serves as an auxiliary device, possibly for connectivity, data transfer, or multitasking alongside the laptop.
parts.Movement_description: It can be detached, moved, or repositioned independently from the laptop.

parts.name: Screen Side
parts.Basic_description: The upper part of the laptop containing the display screen, made of glass and plastic composite.
parts.Functional_description: Displays visual output, user interface, and media content; essential for interaction and viewing.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge to open or close the laptop.

parts.name: Base Side
parts.Basic_description: The bottom part of the laptop that houses the keyboard, touchpad, and internal components, made of aluminum alloy.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the main hardware components, provides typing and control interface, and serves as the main contact surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use but can pivot with the screen via the hinge.
